Deliverable

Accepted actual VENTUNO Q and matched simulation evidence for Diffusion Policy INT4-mixed, using its frozen trained reference.

Execution ownership

This task owns conversion, calibration, load/parity checks, actual board/simulation measurements and required reruns for this profile. SO101-18 owns campaign coordination; SO101-59/60/61/62 aggregate acceptance/coverage/freezing and SO101-45/63 write/review the report. Do not duplicate profile execution in those gates.

Prerequisites and approved choices

Use the frozen Diffusion Policy reference, approved runtime/precision definitions in decision 0002 and assumptions A-001–A-004, and the accepted benchmark/protocol. All nine scored cells use the approved VENTUNO Q Kryo CPU route with one runtime per model across precisions. Conversion preparation may overlap harness delivery; scored comparisons wait for SO101-58 measurement-path acceptance. Do not infer native support or silently substitute another precision/model.

Required evidence

  • Exact frozen reference, model/software/data/split/configuration revisions and profile artifact/checksum.

  • Calibration provenance; exact weight/activation precision, quantized module coverage, exceptions, runtime placement and delegation/kernel evidence.

  • Conversion/load/reference-parity evidence, raw board inference/resource measurements and matched simulation outcomes under the approved protocol.

  • Failures, unsupported paths, reruns and limitations, with reviewer disposition and shared report/manifest links.

Acceptance

  • All required evidence for this profile is linked, reproducible and reviewed using existing approved criteria; no new numerical threshold is introduced here.

  • Board and simulation measurements are identified separately and do not establish physical-arm performance.

  • Unsupported execution is retained as an evidenced blocker and escalated for an explicit scope/runtime decision. Recording a blocker alone does not fulfil this required profile.

Allocation and provenance

Created as PROFILE-09 under the approved 25 October 2026 mapping. Owner, estimate, due date and sprint remain unset pending explicit allocation from the existing plan and actual capacity. Initial To Do does not imply that existing profile evidence has been assessed.
